descriptions.Предварително записване по телефона и оп: Advance enrolment by telephone and a level assessment. The appropriate course, timetable and fee are agreed with the learning centre; this is not a booking for a single lesson.
descriptions.1 час общо: до 40 минути снимане и 20 ми: 1 hour total: up to 40 minutes of photography and 20 minutes for selection; one look and one retouched photograph. Additional photograph: 15 EUR. Unedited photographs are not supplied; payment on the day of the session. The conditions allow portraits to be published; agree privacy requirements before booking.
descriptions.1 час, 3–4 визии. Допълнителен кадър 10: 1 hour, 3–4 looks. Additional photograph 10 EUR; weekends and national holidays +55 EUR. Makeup and hairstyling are separate services. To opt out of portfolio sharing, inform the photographer explicitly in advance.
descriptions.10 EUR за едно посещение без месечна кар: 10 EUR for one visit without a monthly pass. Book through the form for the specific venue; the school confirms the group and place. Not venue hire, an extreme sport or a pass for 8 visits.
descriptions.100 EUR за брой за обикновен DPF/FAP фил: 100 EUR per standard DPF/FAP filter or catalytic converter. Does not include a DPF with AdBlue, which has a separate fee. Removal, installation and software settings are determined separately according to complexity.
descriptions.12 учебни часа общо; предварително запис: 12 teaching hours in total; pre-registration, the place is reserved after payment.
descriptions.12,27 € за учебен час от 45 минути, не з: 12.27 € per academic hour of 45 minutes, not for a complete course. Recommended 50 academic hours; final scope after a placement test. Textbooks are separate. In-person format, schedule and payment are confirmed in advance. Rescheduling requires 2 days' notice, or 5 hours in an emergency.
120–180 minutes, according to length and design.
descriptions.15 € за брой; минимална поръчка за посещ: 15 € per item; minimum order for a visit in Sofia 25 €. Heavy soiling: +50%; blue/green parking-zone charges are separate. Notify the provider if there is no lift: floors 3 and above are not served without one. The exact price is confirmed before work.
15–40 minutes, according to the required repair.
descriptions.16 EUR за целия корт за 60 минути, понед: 16 EUR for the whole court for 60 minutes, Monday–Friday with start 07:00–16:00. from 17:00 and over the weekend the published fee is 22 EUR. It's not a coaching lesson, a free first lesson, or a price per person/subscription.
descriptions.16 учебни часа общо; предварително запис: 16 teaching hours in total; pre-enrollment for attendance group.
descriptions.2 визии, гардероб и обработени дигитални: 2 looks, wardrobe and edited digital photographs. Additional photograph 12 EUR; approximately 2–3 hours, not a fixed duration. The price includes use of photographs in the photographer's portfolio; privacy is agreed in advance.
descriptions.2 часа общо: до 90 минути снимане и 30 м: 2 hours total: up to 90 minutes of photography and 30 minutes for selection; three looks and six retouched photographs. Additional photograph: 15 EUR. Unedited photographs are not supplied; payment on the day of the session. The conditions allow portraits to be published; agree privacy requirements before booking.
descriptions.2 часа с всички материали и чаша вино ил: 2 hours with all materials and a glass of wine or soft drink. Choose a wine glass, vase/garaf or glass ball. Online or on-site payment; Cancel ≥24 hours with full return, under 24 hours without recovery.
descriptions.20 EUR е само за сваляне/качване на 4 гу: 20 EUR is only for removing/refitting 4 tyres already on rims on a passenger car. A visit to an address in Sofia is charged separately: 15 EUR. Not tyre removal/installation on a rim or balancing; additional work is agreed separately.
descriptions.20 EUR е само треньорът. Кортът се плаща: 20 EUR covers only the coach. Court hire is charged separately per person: 8 EUR on weekdays 08–17 h; 11 EUR on weekdays 17–22 h and weekends 08–22 h. Rackets and shuttlecocks are included when a coach is hired. Not the final total lesson price.
descriptions.20,45 EUR за единично групово посещение: 20,45 EUR for a single group visit without a package. Recording by phone; Prepayment may be required. Cancel or change to12hours before the start. It's not the individual rate33,23 EUR or split package.
descriptions.23 EUR включва инструктор, екипировка и: 23 EUR includes instructor, equipment and hall fee. Insurance is not included. The time is agreed in advance.
descriptions.25 EUR за една тренировка с един участни: 25 EUR for one training session with one participant. The individual activity is arranged in advance after an inquiry by phone. It is not free swimming, trial free visit, card or price for two/three.
descriptions.25 € за учебен час от 50 минути. Начало: 25 € for a class of 50 minutes. Start after language level determination and prepayment at a minimum 5 the lesson; The schedule is arranged by phone.
descriptions.270 € само с предварително пълно плащане: 270 € only with advance full payment; regular price 290 € or 2×145 €. Group 21.11–12.12.2026: 4 Saturdays 6 hours; there are separate January groups. Cancel: ≥20 days of full return, 7–19 days 50%, under 7 days without return.
descriptions.2–3 визии. Уикенд/празник: +50 EUR; близ: 2–3 looks. Weekends/holidays: +50 EUR; twins: +50%. The standard price includes consent for portfolio/advertising use; complete confidentiality costs 2× the package by prior agreement.
descriptions.2–3 часа; до 12 души в ателието, след за: 2–3 hours; up to 12 people at the studio, following an enquiry.
descriptions.30 EUR за един час ползване на тенис кор: 30 EUR for one hour use of tennis court in November–April, VAT included. The time is agreed in advance by phone. It is not a lesson with a coach, the summer reduced mode or a common gym/pool entrance.
descriptions.30 избрани кадъра; допълнителен кадър 5,: 30 selected frames; extra frame 5,11 €. Cloud Gallery for 1 month. Keeping a date with the photographer; Portfolio usage is described in its privacy policy.
descriptions.30 минути. За деца от 6–7 месеца до 10 г: 30 minutes. For children of 6–7 month to 10 years; processed digital photos. Additional frame: 8 EUR. The photographer uses portfolio/advertising footage; the refusal is stated in writing before the session.
descriptions.30 € за кормилен час; записват се миниму: 30 € per steering hour; A minimum of two steering hours shall be recorded. Experience and comfortable schedule are specified in advance with the car school. The duration of one steering hour is not specified in the published tariff.
descriptions.30-минутна устна консултация без отделен: 30-minute verbal consultation without a separate document review. The fee is agreed when booking and paid in advance.
descriptions.32 учебни часа общо; графикът и мястото: 32 teaching hours in total; the schedule and place are confirmed upon enrollment.
